atoms.exact_source_text: At Home, the crunch subject is the Colony. Citizens contribute in equal, individually apportioned shares; good stewardship creates a stable home that can run well, make room for ambition, and permit ordinary life to be experienced.
atoms.normalized_claim: The canonical premise states that at Home the crunch subject is the Colony, Citizens contribute equal individually apportioned shares, and good stewardship creates a stable home enabling ambition and ordinary life.

atoms.exact_source_text: Buildings no longer operate primarily as stand-alone factories. Places support Practices; Citizens occupy Roles; the colony succeeds as a whole.
atoms.normalized_claim: The reworked colony posture model replaces stand-alone factory buildings: Places support Practices, Citizens occupy Roles, and the colony succeeds as a whole.

atoms.exact_source_text: | RTS production grid     | Colony posture               | Buildings no longer operate primarily as stand-alone factories. Places support Practices; Citizens occupy Roles; the colony succeeds as a whole. |
atoms.normalized_claim: The prior RTS production grid model was reworked into a Colony posture model with the described system consequence.

atoms.exact_source_text: Each assigned Citizen contributes one unit of Role Capacity at Home. Personal aptitudes belong to Away Mode, not domestic productivity ranking.
atoms.normalized_claim: Under the equal civic shares model, each assigned Citizen contributes one unit of Role Capacity at Home, while personal aptitudes belong to Away Mode rather than domestic productivity ranking.

atoms.exact_source_text: | Worker optimization     | Equal civic shares           | Each assigned Citizen contributes one unit of Role Capacity at Home. Personal aptitudes belong to Away Mode, not domestic productivity ranking.  |
atoms.normalized_claim: The prior worker optimization model was reworked into equal civic shares with the described system consequence.

atoms.exact_source_text: Adequate coverage can fully absorb routine load. The colony is allowed to become genuinely stable rather than merely decay more slowly.
atoms.normalized_claim: Under the achievable equilibrium model, adequate coverage can fully absorb routine load and the colony can become genuinely stable rather than merely decay more slowly.

atoms.exact_source_text: | Continuous entropy      | Achievable equilibrium       | Adequate coverage can fully absorb routine load. The colony is allowed to become genuinely stable rather than merely decay more slowly.          |
atoms.normalized_claim: The prior continuous entropy model was reworked into achievable equilibrium with the described system consequence.

atoms.exact_source_text: | Local repair clicking   | Global condition             | Diffuse wear, flood strain, loosened lashings, and ordinary upkeep are compressed into colony-scale Conditions.                                  |
atoms.normalized_claim: The prior local repair clicking model was reworked into global condition, compressing diffuse wear, flood strain, loosened lashings, and ordinary upkeep into colony-scale Conditions.

atoms.exact_source_text: Role shortfalls create deficiencies and exposure. They do not automatically inflict daily punishment in every affected category.
atoms.normalized_claim: Under the latent vulnerability model, Role shortfalls create deficiencies and exposure but do not automatically inflict daily punishment in every affected category.

atoms.exact_source_text: | Passive debuffs         | Latent vulnerability         | Role shortfalls create deficiencies and exposure. They do not automatically inflict daily punishment in every affected category.                 |
atoms.normalized_claim: The prior passive debuffs model was reworked into latent vulnerability with the described system consequence.

atoms.exact_source_text: A hidden Role ledger controls shortfall-Encounter pressure. The two most relevant weak points determine how a Colony Encounter manifests.
atoms.normalized_claim: Under the weakness-shaped MEET model, a hidden Role ledger controls shortfall-Encounter pressure and the two most relevant weak points determine how a Colony Encounter manifests.

atoms.exact_source_text: | Generic random events   | Weakness-shaped MEET         | A hidden Role ledger controls shortfall-Encounter pressure. The two most relevant weak points determine how a Colony Encounter manifests.        |
atoms.normalized_claim: The prior generic random events model was reworked into weakness-shaped MEET with the described system consequence.

atoms.exact_source_text: A Home Encounter normally offers two different spends protecting different stakes, or a refusal that suffers the compound result.
atoms.normalized_claim: Under the three-choice transaction model, a Home Encounter normally offers two different spends protecting different stakes, or a refusal that suffers the compound result.

atoms.exact_source_text: Competent Dwell produces mental and calendar space. EMBODY becomes globally available at Home for any present, available Citizen.
atoms.normalized_claim: Under the Quiet Equilibrium and EMBODY model, competent Dwell produces mental and calendar space, and EMBODY becomes globally available at Home for any present, available Citizen.

atoms.exact_source_text: | Flavor text as reward   | Quiet Equilibrium and EMBODY | Competent Dwell produces mental and calendar space. EMBODY becomes globally available at Home for any present, available Citizen.                |
atoms.normalized_claim: The prior flavor text as reward model was reworked into Quiet Equilibrium and EMBODY with the described system consequence.

atoms.exact_source_text: The Home Loop is the operating architecture of the Colony Register (DWELL).
atoms.normalized_claim: The Home Loop is defined as the operating architecture of the Colony Register (DWELL).

atoms.exact_source_text: It replaces the familiar base-builder model of isolated production buildings, service radii, worker throughput, and continuous attrition with a colony-scale stewardship system organized around Places, Practices, Roles, Readiness, and situated Encounters.
atoms.normalized_claim: The Home Loop replaces the base-builder model of isolated production buildings, service radii, worker throughput, and continuous attrition with a colony-scale stewardship system organized around Places, Practices, Roles, Readiness, and situated Encounters.
